name: AionUi
description: Runs a built-in agent plus Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and 20+ CLI agents in one desktop cowork app, with team mode, scheduled tasks, MCP management, and WebUI remote access.

skills.name: Multi-Agent Mode
skills.description: Auto-detects installed CLI agents and runs them in parallel sessions under one interface.

skills.name: Team Mode
skills.description: Has a leader agent split work and delegate subtasks to teammate agents through a built-in Team MCP server.

skills.name: Scheduled Tasks
skills.description: Runs agent tasks on cron, fixed-interval, or one-time schedules.

skills.name: Assistants and Skills
skills.description: Ships 21 built-in assistants and a three-tier skill system you can extend.

skills.name: Remote Access
skills.description: Reaches the app from a browser via WebUI or from Telegram, Lark, DingTalk, and WeChat.
